scoring_justification: Cannot recompute λ from raw α²F(ω) (not in output contract); Tc trend is scored structurally. λ is scored via reference_match with tolerance.

hidden_assets.purpose: hidden gold values for λ_ac=0.71 and λ_op=0.21
hidden_assets.source_provenance: Paper: JETP Lett. 80, 623 (2004); values reported from integration of α²F(ω)
hidden_assets.why_not_fabricated: these are the paper's published electron-phonon coupling constants obtained from the Eliashberg function integration

outputs.description: Contains the computed electron-phonon coupling constants for acoustic and optical modes at ambient pressure, and the critical temperature Tc as a function of volume (V0, 0.85V0, 0.70V0). The Tc values will be checked for physically correct ordering.

output_contract.notes: The agent may use any reasonable Coulomb pseudopotential μ* (e.g., 0.13–0.17). The scoring checks the closeness of λ values to paper-reported references and the physical ordering of Tc with compression.

steps.description: Check λ_ac and λ_op against paper-reported values 0.71 and 0.21 with tolerance ±0.1
Check Tc values: all positive and strictly decreasing with compression: Tc(V0) > Tc(0.85V0) > Tc(0.70V0)
